later_27b.title: Legacy person navigation disabled by default
later_27b.summary: From 27B, the non-Redwood navigation (tiles, quick actions and navigator entries) to the responsive and classic person pages is off by default: My Client Groups, Person Management, Person Spotlight, Me, Directory, My Public Info and My Organization Chart. Oracle says you can still reach them by setting the relevant profile option to No, and that the list of profile options will come in the 27B What's New.
